title: Chapter 395 Bloodstained Great Wall
content:
Chapter 395 Bloodstained Great Wall

It was really heart-wrenching.

And this place was the wall section that Wang Shuo was responsible for defending.

Wang Shuo panicked and his spear skills became more fierce.

But this boss was more difficult to deal with than the tiger just now, because it was a rabbit spirit with high agility, and Wang Shuo's attacks failed several times.

"Gong Zheng, taunt."

Gong Zheng immediately grabbed the rabbit spirit, and Wang Shuo and Ayub immediately released their ultimate moves.

The two ultimate moves fell on the rabbit spirit, directly hitting it seriously and no longer alive.

Then Ayub cut it in half with a knife.

The combat power of the monsters of different races is still very different. For this kind of boss with weak defense, the top warrior Ayub can easily break the defense.

Wang Shuo looked up at the battle situation, and the puppet summoned by Zhu Dongheng was still obviously at a disadvantage.

Moreover, it was difficult for Zhu Dongheng to break the situation when he was besieged by four bosses. He could repel the opponent every time, but he would always be blocked when he wanted to kill.

Wang Shuo wanted to leave and go to support the wall he was defending, but he always felt that he couldn't leave.

If he left, the situation here would be stalemate, and it would be even more uneconomical to hold back a mid-level general.

Wang Shuo was in a dilemma.

"Zhu Junshou, look." Wang Shuo pointed at the beacon tower, with an anxious look on his face.

Zhu Dongheng took a look, moved his feet lightly, slashed at a monkey boss with a sword, and said to Wang Shuo: "You go first, I can handle this."

Wang Shuo turned around, rode on Da Huang, took Ayubu and Gong Zheng, and quickly returned to the wall he was defending.

Wang Shuo remembered that Li Weiguo and Li Baoguo were in charge of that section of the wall.

This was also an important reason why Wang Shuo was very worried.

This was his beloved general, and he must not lose him here.

Along the way, Wang Shuo killed various monsters clinging to the battlements, relieving the pressure on the soldiers.

When he arrived at Li Weiguo and his men,

Wang Shuo found that there were only two general-level bosses. Fortunately, the situation could still be controlled.

Just because this section of the city wall had natural barriers, Wang Shuo did not deploy a large number of high-end combat forces here, but he did not expect that the monster would have two general-level bosses climbing the city wall.

The general monster kicked Li Weiguo away.

Wang Shuo helped him up and asked, "What's the situation?"

"The city wall in front has been occupied by monsters."

Wang Shuo's heart sank. It seemed that the situation was more serious than he imagined.

"Where are the reserves?"

"They are blocked under the city wall and can't come up."

Wang Shuo didn't waste any words and rushed up directly.

The role of high-end combat forces on the battlefield is really too great.

In desperation, Wang Shuo could only release the three-headed dog of hell to relieve the pressure on the city wall.

The three-headed dog of hell is more precious than the soldiers.

Soldiers can be supplemented by summoning tools, and the reproduction speed of the three-headed dog of hell can be said to be very slow.

Due to the terrain restrictions of the city wall, Wang Shuo only released more than 100.

Wang Shuo immediately fought with a war general boss.

Looking down at the Great Wall from a high altitude.

The closer to the middle part of the entire city wall, the more tragic the battle.

The city wall was full of corpses of monsters and human soldiers, and there was no place to stand in many places.

The defending soldiers had to throw the corpses off the city wall.

The blood flowed along the drainage ditch, dyeing the outer wall of the Great Wall blood red.

The soldiers who had not yet stepped onto the city wall couldn't help breathing heavily and their legs trembling when they saw this scene.

Especially some new recruits who had not experienced a big war were already shaking all over, like sifting chaff.

When they saw the wounded soldiers retreating from the city wall, missing arms and legs, they were filled with fear.

War has always been cruel.
